# AI Consumption Notes

AI may assist with:

- Interview summarization
- Theme clustering
- Usability issue detection
- Journey mapping
- Accessibility recommendations
- UX insight generation

AI-generated UX insights shall be validated using actual user research before influencing design decisions.
